summary: User sent 2000 USDT via Avalanche C-Chain to a Coinbase Avalanche deposit address even though Coinbase did not support USDT deposits on that network leaving the funds inaccessible
user_mistake: sent USDT using an unsupported network and asset combination
prevention: Check Coinbase supports USDT specifically on Avalanche C-Chain before transferring / Match both the asset and network shown on the Coinbase deposit screen
